#!/bin/sh
set -eu

case "$1 ${2:-}" in
  "intent shape")
    slug=$3
    project=
    while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
      if [ "$1" = --project ]; then
        project=$2
        shift 2
      else
        shift
      fi
    done
    shape_dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kogen-shaper/$slug/fake-shape"
    mkdir -p "$shape_dir"
    printf '%s\n' '{"stage":"shape","outcome":"ok","retries":0}' > "$shape_dir/requests.jsonl"
    [ -z "${FAKE_KOGEN_SHAPE_EXIT:-}" ] || exit "$FAKE_KOGEN_SHAPE_EXIT"
    mkdir -p "$project/.kogen/intents/$slug"
    printf '%s\n' 'shaped Intent' > "$project/.kogen/intents/$slug/intent.md"
    printf '%s\n' '{"slug":"task","usage":[]}'
    ;;
  "intent approve")
    exit 0
    ;;
  "queue start")
    if [ -n "${FAKE_KOGEN_BEST:-}" ]; then
      shift 2
      project=
      origin=
      while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
        case "$1" in
          --project) project=$2; shift 2 ;;
          --origin) origin=$2; shift 2 ;;
          *) shift ;;
        esac
      done
      clone="$project/.kogen/best-candidate"
      git clone --quiet "$origin" "$clone"
      printf '%s\n' 'best candidate implementation' > "$clone/best.txt"
      git -C "$clone" add best.txt
      git -C "$clone" -c user.name='Fake Kogen' -c user.email=fake@kogen.invalid \
        -c commit.gpgsign=false commit --quiet -m 'Best candidate'
      git -C "$clone" push --quiet origin HEAD:refs/heads/kogen/task
    fi
    exit 1
    ;;
  "status "*)
    shift 2
    project=
    while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
      if [ "$1" = --project ]; then
        project=$2
        shift 2
      else
        shift
      fi
    done
    run_dir="$project/.kogen/test-run"
    mkdir -p "$run_dir"
    printf '%s\n' 'candidate implementation' > "$run_dir/candidate.diff"
    printf '%s\n' '{"stage":"develop","outcome":"ok","retries":0}' \
      '{"stage":"develop","outcome":"timeout","retries":0}' > "$run_dir/requests.jsonl"
    python3 - "$run_dir/candidate.diff" "$run_dir" <<'PY'
import json
import os
import sys

source_path, journal = sys.argv[1:]
best = None
if os.environ.get("FAKE_KOGEN_BEST"):
    best = {
        "attempt": "sol-high",
        "branch": "kogen/task",
        "failing": {"acceptance": ["A1"], "red_checks": ["tests"]},
    }
print(json.dumps({
    "status": "failed",
    "journal": journal,
    "best_candidate": best,
    "candidate_diffs": [{
        "attempt": "builder",
        "file": "candidate.diff",
        "source_path": source_path,
        "protected_paths_changed": [],
        "red_checks": [{"name": "tests", "exit_level": 1}],
        "acceptance_items": [{"id": "A1"}],
    }],
    "attempts": [],
    "escalations": [],
    "model_stages": [{
        "stage": "develop",
        "attempt": "builder",
        "model": "gpt-6-luna",
        "effort": "max",
        "tokens": {"input": 300, "output": 30},
        "wall_ms": 0,
        "partial": True,
    }],
    "phase_timings": [],
}))
PY

    ;;
  *)
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
